known_differences.description: fsci-cluster implements vq (kmeans, kmeans2, whiten, vq) and hierarchy (linkage, fcluster, cophenet, inconsistent).

threats.description: Constant or zero-variance feature columns in whiten cause division by zero or NaN feature scaling.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-cluster/src/lib.rs:4094 (whiten): detects zero standard deviation columns and leaves them unscaled (or emits BoundedRecovery in Hardened mode).
threats.strict_mode_response: Match SciPy whiten handling of zero-variance columns.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Avoid division by zero and record BoundedRecovery in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Empty observation matrices, k == 0 clusters, or non-finite coordinates passed to kmeans / linkage.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-cluster/src/lib.rs:2879 (kmeans): validates observation shape, k >= 1, and finiteness before Lloyd iterations, recording FailClosed on error.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(ClusterError) and emit FailClosed audit event.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite or malformed observations fail-closed.

threats.description: Pairwise distance accumulation in agglomerative linkage exhausting memory on malformed condensed vectors.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-cluster/src/lib.rs:4594 (linkage): verifies condensed distance length n*(n-1)/2 and finite entries before MST/NN-chain clustering.
threats.strict_mode_response: Reject invalid condensed distance lengths immediately.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject invalid lengths or non-finite distances fail-closed.

threats.description: Invalid linkage matrix rows (negative distances, out-of-range cluster indices) passed to fcluster.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-cluster/src/lib.rs:5075 (fcluster): validates linkage matrix dimensions and merge index bounds before cutting tree.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(ClusterError) on invalid linkage matrix.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject malformed linkage tree fail-closed with audit entry.

fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Return ClusterError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return ClusterError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
Return ClusterError::NonFiniteInput and emit FailClosed audit event.
Return ClusterError::InvalidLinkage and log FailClosed event.
